role: Existing geometrical-parameter .ffe result reader/resource, not a new original FormatRef, exporter or external ORFFE calculation.

grammar.atomic: ATOMIC PARAMETERS FOR PHASE marker, two header lines, selected rows with14scanf fields: ordinal,label<=6sourcebytes and six alternating float/int pairs. Native uses successfully parsed row count for compatibility; annotations are not a replacement crystal structure.
grammar.symmetry: SYMMETRY INFORMATION, two header lines, optional indexed three affine-expression tokens; native separately prepends identity. Source empty extra-operation section yields one internal identity. Do not silently add another identity or require source operation code1 for identity.
grammar.distance: INTERATOMIC DISTANCE IN ANGSTROMS; serial, two(siteOrdinal,encodedSymmetryCode) operands, two label/fractional-coordinate annotations; next line value +OR- SU. Preserve source order, original decimals and implicit f32 narrowing separately.
grammar.angle: BOND ANGLE IN DEGREES. CENTRAL ATOM IS VERTEX marker spelling follows locked original; analogous three operands and annotations, middle operand is vertex; next line value +OR- SU.
grammar.other: CELL PARAMETERS/native skip states and unrecognized original text remain exact source. Unsupported result/header forms are source-only with diagnostics, not invented complete active tables.

identity.owner: Source table binds captured phase source/root/basis and resource digest before association. Every pair/triplet ordinal maps through the exact source site table to stable SiteId; ordinal/label alone isnot a global ID.
identity.native: Read result site ordinal becomes ordinal-1. Encoded symmetry code is split with C++ signed quotient/remainder by1000; remainder selects the separately identity-prefixed operator vector, quotient indexes a native translation table. It isnot universally a positive1-based operation ID.
identity.selectedActive: Current old positive has code0 and no extra symmetry rows. Broader code/translation interpretation requires a qualified full table/basis rule and bounds; preserve original code/expression bytes and refuse active mapping otherwise. Never reinterpret an invalid code by modulo wrapping.
identity.sourceConsistency: Counts alone are insufficient. Bind labels/source coordinates/qualified operation/basis/image mapping and immutable phase source digest. Swapped or edited site tables cannot borrow old resource identity; use versioned revalidation and preserve original raw table.
identity.values: These are external source results. The authored9.8765/.0123 and123.456/.0045 deliberately differ from model2angstrom/90degrees; do not recompute and overwrite them or call sourceSU a numerical error allowance. ScalarSU isnot full covariance.

numeric.units: Distanceangstrom, angledegree from explicit section headings. Unknown section/kind stays source-only. SU same unit, finite nonnegative for active table; original signed spelling remains source.
numeric.precision: Keep each original decimal token exactly; selected native presentation parses%f and storesbinary32 for value/SU. Prospective decimal->f32 plus explicit display rule must be separate from raw preservation. Do not use displayed9.877(13) as full-precision source.
numeric.rejection: Missing next line, malformed value/SU, nonfinite active results, negativeSU, out-of-range site/operator/translation, duplicate ambiguous identity or count mismatch cannot materialize a new active table from stale locals.

failure.original: R80 bad-count read produces empty lists/stale old detail and SaveAs removes IMPORT_ORFFE; recorded as actual failure, not future preserving behavior.
failure.proposed: Parse/capture/reconcile into a private candidate. A failed read keeps previous valid project/table/resource binding and reports which new input failed; no replacing old data, clearing reference, or displaying stale detail as a result from the failed source. On success replace atomically and reset selection/details to the new table.
failure.wholeSave: Existing explicit IMPORT_ORFFE is a required dependency/effect. Wrongcount/unknownmapping/ignored present table is E_REOPEN_COVERAGE or diagnostic recovery, never a validSaved just because its fileSHA matches. Original safe raw table/source observations remain independently retained.
failure.optional: Initial .ins/.lst same-stem discovery may be absent per resource-graph.contract; once present or explicitly linked it cannot downgrade to absent to mask failure.

expectedReopen.table: Full source row count/order, row serial/kind, pair/triplet source IDs/images, value/SU original tokens, printed/native projection and owner/resource relation. Candidate decode must reconstruct the table or retain explicitly source-only qualification; rawbyte presence doesnot grant active geometry.
expectedReopen.future: Use actual product write, independent source-table read and fresh-instance reopen; test failed replacement after valid linkage, same-count wrong identity and no oldcache fallback. Historical scoped positive .ffe reopen doesnot reverse actual pgrid reopen failure.
expectedReopen.sourceModel: Use phase-owned SourceMetadata.tree map/array nodes and raw resource spans with completeSourceLedger; active projected table consumes existing source/SG identity qualifications. No new covariance/scientific operator capability.
